subject: Copywriting
title: The Attention Economy
description: A quick, practical guide to The Attention Economy.

hook.text: Humans check their phones 96 times per day. Every check is a persuasion opportunity. Attention is the new currency.

buildup.text: Herbert Simon called it in 1971: 'A wealth of information creates a poverty of attention.' Social media proved it.

twist.text: Attention-seeking design—infinite scroll, autoplay, notifications—uses the same psychology as slot machines.

climax.text: The attention economy turns every copywriter into a propagandist for engagement.

punchline.text: 96 phone checks daily. Attention is the most competed-for resource.

quiz.question: Who predicted that information wealth would create attention poverty?
